_about: Data for the Sekelo station (formerly the Mishkaki grill; design system §15), the combined station js/cook/stations/mishkaki-grill.js. `station`: its name, goal and one line per phase. `words` are the skewer kinds the order names (the family's words, 26 Sept: gos = meat (ph-meat), boga = vegetable, mixed; each is said after lakri, the skewer: ba lakri gos). `mechanic.skewer` is shared by the thread and grill mechanics: which piece is meat or veg (`classes`), which word names which kind of skewer (`kinds`), and how each piece is drawn on a skewer (`art`, placeholder). `mechanic.levels`: which level each zone's mechanic runs at (the grill's own levels in data/cook.json add spots and speed) and `juggle`. Wave 6 (docs/UX-PRINCIPLES.md 5): one job at a time: thread every skewer, press "Go to the barbecue", then grill them. `juggle: true` (level 4, optional, for older children) is the old two-zone screen, threading while the grill cooks. The order's shape per level (1 skewer; 2; 2-3 with a mixed one; 3-4) is the mishkaki recipe's `skewers` slot.

station.name: Sekelo
station.goal: Thread the skewers they asked for. Then take them to the grill: turn each one, and lift it onto the plate.

phases.thread: Tap the bowls to thread each skewer the way they said. Then tap "to the grill".
phases.grill: Tap a skewer on the rack to grill it. Turn it on the green, then lift it onto the plate.

ph-veg.src: Mum 26 Sept (Section B, B17; docs/kutchi-grammar-notes.md §25): boga, the family's word (from Swahili)

ph-mixed.src: Mum 26 Sept (Section B, B18; docs/kutchi-grammar-notes.md §25): mixed, the English word
ph-mixed._note: a skewer of meat and vegetables, threaded in the order said

skewer._unit: the word said before a skewer's kind when Nani repeats it (hakri lakri gos, ba lakri boga): the same as the mishkaki recipe's tally `unit`
skewer._pieces: Design system §15 (Zafar, 29 Sept): mishkaki now means only the square meat cubes, so the meat PIECE is ph-mishkaki (the bowl's chip, the word pop, a mixed skewer's parts); ph-meat (gos) stays the KIND word of an all-meat skewer in the order (ba lakri gos: to confirm).

bowls._about: front-on prep bowls on the shelf band (build/gen_sekelo_v2.py, build/cut_sekelo_v2.py)

mechanic._juggle: Sekelo v2 (§15): one job at a time at every level (thread, then the grill); the juggle screen is off (it had no shelf band).
